article.title: Which of two possible constructions preferred.
article.content: Where a clause is susceptible of two meanings according to one of which it has some effect, and according to the other of which it can have none, the former shall be preferred.
article.html:
84Which of two possible constructions preferred.

Section 84 · Part VI · Chapter VI · page 34 of the Act

Where a clause is susceptible of two meanings according to one of which it has some effect, and according to the other of which it can have none, the former shall be preferred.
